text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm starting the relnotes draft for the docs site deploy (0.10.0). Need a quick sweep for: known issues, SDK snippet parity, and any link redirects. Base PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823

maria: On it. I'll scan the release checklist and the migration-guide for broken anchors / redirects. Any locales affected?

sam: @maria yes — zh and fr versions still point to old snippet names. We should unify to the new client API before publishing.

jordan: Found one orphan link in migration-guide -> old-quantization. Looks like the target doc got renamed. I'll open a tiny PR with a redirect entry.

alex: Great. Also, can we pin the SDK examples to the new client calls? Replace Client.create -> RedwoodClient.init and update the responses example. Avoid duplicate variants.

maria: I'll grep for "Client.create" across /docs and stage a patch. Also QA reported an embedding streaming edge-case: long-doc chunking in examples returns intermittent 403s in the test harness.

docs-bot: deploy-bot queued docs build #512 — status: pending

sam: Plan: batch small fixes (link redirects + snippet updates + one-liner changelog bullets) into a single relnotes PR to reduce churn. Anyone object?

jordan: :+1: less noise sounds good.

lina: Adding a Known Issue bullet: "Embeddings streaming may regress on >8k tokens; workaround: set batch_size=1 and enable prefix_cache." I'll paste a repro snippet and the internal eval id: EVAL-2024-09-01.

maria: Put the workaround under "Known issues" and include a short troubleshooting section. Also filed INTL-722 for i18n check on those pages.

alex: Can we also include a brief migration note for Dedicated customers about routing policy v2? It's subtle (fallback ordering changed). Two-line blurb should suffice.

sam: I'll draft the migration blurb now. Posting suggested copy: "Routing policy v2 changes fallback ordering to prefer lower-latency regional variants. Customers pinning models should verify rollout policies after upgrade; contact SE for assisted migration."

sam: Draft SDK snippet for the relnotes (JS):
```javascript
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: "redwood-kestrel-1",
  input: "Summarize the doc",
});
console.log(res.output_text);
```

maria: Use lowercase `responses.create` (matches new API), and prefer `await client.responses.create({...})` as shown. I'll patch a couple of examples to match.

ajex: (typo) — alex: OK. Let's aim to publish relnotes on 2024-10-02 16:00 PT. Cutoff for copy and localization: 2024-09-30 EOD.

jordan: Opening PR with linkfix + snippet updates now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4831

docs-bot: CI: build succeeded for PR #4831

maria: Merged #4831. Also created INTL ticket and added a short comment to translators with the sample parity list.

alex: Thanks team. Sam — drop the final blurb into the relnotes PR description and I'll do a quick edit pass.

sam: Done — PR description updated with the blurb and the Known Issue bullet. Ping me for last-minute copy changes.

maria: Quick note — we should include the small migration subsection in the top-level changelog and add a direct link from the Dedicated docs page to avoid support tickets.

alex: Agreed. I'll add that link and queue the final review. Thanks all :rocket:
